patch_description: Refactor the ANSATZ_SPEC to dynamically generate the circuit using a loop. Update the parameter sharing strategy from fully collective (1 parameter across all 8 wires) to bipartite (2 parameters, split by the parity of the qubit's binary index). Because the hypercube entangler exactly connects opposite parities, this splits the circuit into two fully-interacting halves and doubles expressiveness with minimal parameter inflation.
